title: Cassia auriculata tea for medicinal use
intro: Cassia auriculata tea is a traditional herbal preparation made from the dried flowers of the Cassia auriculata plant, commonly known as the "golden shower" tree. This tea is used in herbalism to support digestive health and has mild laxative properties. It is often consumed to relieve constipation and promote regular bowel movements. The tea may also help reduce inflammation and is sometimes used in skincare for its soothing effects. In traditional medicine, it is valued for its ability to balance internal body functions and support overall wellness.
